method: Same never-considered pool as round 1 (807 mats), re-scored against all 43 live albums with no per-album cap (scripts/audits/album_missed_round2_nov07.py: back-colour share + dominant-colour-is-back bonus, multicolour credit by count of set colours present, explained-colour fit, tone gate; tile profiles corrected by looking, PROFILE_FIX). Selection: score>=4.3, or within 85% of the mat's best album (>=3.7), or top-12 per album (>=3.0); then by-eye contact-sheet pass removed 473 clear misses (r2-by-eye-pruned.json); a second extension pass (scores 3.3+ within 72% of the mat's best) was looked at for 20 albums and 92 pairs added (r2-ext-kept.json). Round-1 yeses (config/picks/missed-mats-round1-2026-11-07.txt) are shown locked and not counted as new.
